items.title: Samsung Enters Open-Ear Market With Clip-On Galaxy Buds On
items.summary: Samsung unveiled its first clip-on, open-ear wireless earbuds, leaving the ear canal open for situational awareness. The Buds On feature TwinBoost speakers, Audio Leakage Reduction, Gemini Live, head gestures and up to 9.5 hours of playback, launching in South Korea on October 27 at KRW 299,000.

items.title: Noise Master Buds Open Open Pre-Bookings Ahead of October 23 India Launch
items.summary: Indian brand Noise opened pre-bookings for its first Sound by Bose clip-on open-ear earbuds at Rs 999. The Master Buds Open use a C-bridge design, 10.8mm drivers, 4-mic ENC, Bluetooth 5.4 and up to 28 hours of playback, launching October 23 at an introductory Rs 7,999.

items.title: Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) Review: King of Clip-Ons Re-Crowned
items.summary: The second-generation Bose Ultra Open Earbuds add a redesigned driver for deeper bass, a wireless charging case, Cinema Mode and longer battery life (9 hours per charge). Reviewers praise greatly improved sound over the original while noting the $299 price is harder to justify against cheaper clip-on rivals.

items.title: Shokz Launches OpenDots 2 Clip-On Earbuds in the UAE
items.summary: Shokz introduced the OpenDots 2 open-ear clip-on earbuds in the UAE, built on Bassphere 2.0 dual drivers, upgraded Dolby Audio and DirectPitch leakage reduction. The buds offer up to 10 hours of playback (40 with case), IP57 rating, Bluetooth 6.1 and interchangeable left/right wearing, priced at AED 699.

items.title: Fairphone Fairbuds 2 Set for October 14 Launch With Modular Repairability and LDAC
items.summary: Fairphone will unveil the Fairbuds 2 on October 14, keeping seven fully replaceable modular parts for easy repair. The new wireless earbuds add Sony LDAC hi-res codec support alongside SBC and AAC, launching in Europe at EUR 119 and the US at USD 119.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Review: Premium Flagship, Better Tuned and Easier to Live With
items.summary: Sony's WF-1000XM6 refine the fit, tuning, transparency and call quality of the XM5 with a new QN3e processor and eight-microphone array. Reviewers call them among the best premium true wireless earbuds, though the larger case and in-ear foam tips remain divisive.

items.title: Apple AirPods Pro 3 Review: Heart-Rate Sensing and Live Translation Redefine the Buds
items.summary: The AirPods Pro 3 add a built-in heart-rate sensor, real-time Live Translation across languages and a hearing-aid mode within Apple's ecosystem. Reviewers highlight best-in-class in-ear ANC and fitness tracking, while most smart features remain iPhone-exclusive.

items.title: Anker Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro Review: Outstanding Calls Powered by the Thus AI Chip
items.summary: Anker's flagship Liberty 5 Pro earbuds run on the new Thus on-device AI chip for class-leading call clarity and adaptive ANC. CNET praises very good sound, robust features and a case touchscreen, awarding it an Editors' Choice at around USD 170.

items.title: Omdia: OWS Shipments Grow 12% as TWS Market Stays Broadly Flat in Q2 2026
items.summary: Omdia reports global true wireless stereo shipments fell 0.7% year-over-year to 82.1 million units in Q2 2026, the first annual decline since 2023. Open wireless stereo grew 12% to 11.1 million units, with clip-on designs taking 61% of OWS volume; OWS is forecast to reach 90.5 million units by 2030.

items.title: Open-Ear Earbuds Are Booming While Traditional TWS Stalls
items.summary: A market analysis of Omdia data shows open-ear wireless stereo climbing 12% in Q2 2026 even as conventional TWS declined 2%. Clip-on models led growth and the sub-$50 tier surged 323% year-over-year, signaling open-ear audio is moving from fitness niche to mainstream.
